create_LanguageTagger: create a LanguageTagger instance with specified languages, threshold, and backend for document language detection
run_LanguageTagger: run the LanguageTagger pipeline step on an iterable of Document objects to tag each with language metadata
test__alpha_ratio: test the _alpha_ratio method to compute the ratio of alphabetic characters in a text string
refactor__get_alpha_length: refactor the _get_alpha_length method to calculate the UTF-8 byte length of alphabetic characters in text
review_LanguageTagger_run: review the LanguageTagger run method that performs per-page and full-document language detection with metadata tagging
